question: What do we actually know about Trump's health?

lines.text: At the 9/11 memorial, the right side of Trump's face was seen drooping. For the second year running.

scene.head: 11 SEP
scene.label: right side of face seen drooping
scene.detail: same sign reported at the 2025 memorial

lines.text: A critical care doctor watching the footage put it plainly.

scene.who: Dr Nick Mark, critical care, on X

lines.text: He also struggled to stay awake. The White House did not comment.
He is 80, the oldest president ever sworn in.
On record: swollen legs from a vein condition, and bruised hands his doctor blames on handshakes and aspirin.
In May, his doctor called him in excellent health, with 30 out of 30 on a cognitive test.
So: the doctor says excellent. The cameras raise questions. And no doctor has confirmed a stroke.

caption: At the 9/11 memorial, Trump's face was seen drooping for the second year running, and a doctor called it a facial droop. His May physical said excellent health and 30/30 on a cognitive test. Here's what's on record, and what isn't. No stroke has been confirmed.
